tools.name: understand_site
tools.description: What Straws Soda is, where the shop is, and what this server will not do. Call this first.

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Public address, phone, email, weekly hours, and whether the drive-thru is open right now.

tools.name: list_menu
tools.description: Public drink menu from the live catalog, or shipped merch. Prices are integer cents. Does not place an order.

tools.name: match_intent
tools.description: Classify a visitor message and return the next public URL. Order lookup, punch balances, and hiring are not guest-order conversions.

tools.name: recommend_path
tools.description: Return the canonical public URL for a known goal. Use match_intent when the goal is unclear.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_location · Public sink: get_location.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_location · Public sink: get_location

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
